facts.fact: CIVIX (Cote d'Ivoire Internet Exchange), the national exchange point, has been operational for more than a decade and federates telecom operators and ISPs, per Fraternite Matin reporting the ARTCI PeeringDay 2026 in Abidjan.
Traffic: 36 Gbps (average daily) at CIVIX on 2026-06-15, as stated at the ARTCI PeeringDay 2026; the article gives no measurement date, so the forum date is used.
Netflix and Akamai are among the international content players that CIVIX federates alongside operators and ISPs, per the article on PeeringDay 2026.
